generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?timeHorizon (AVG(xsd:decimal(?change)) AS ?avgChange) (SUM(xsd:decimal(?change)) AS ?totalChange) (COUNT(?sr) AS ?recordCount)
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:timeHorizon ?timeHorizon . }
  ?inv wm:hasScenarioRebalancing ?sr .
  ?sr a wm:ScenarioRebalancing .
  ?sr wm:currentAllocationPct ?curr .
  ?sr wm:newAllocationPct ?new .
  FILTER (BOUND(?curr) && BOUND(?new))
  BIND ((xsd:decimal(?new) - xsd:decimal(?curr)) AS ?change)
}
GROUP BY ?timeHorizon
